reason: Correct TOP projection of fore-aft-axis drum to match unchanged perspective/side; F03 TOP forward wing sweep.

variants.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Make a LIMITED PROJECTION CORRECTION of IMAGE 1, the new F03/F04 fighter sheet. Preserve the entire LARGE PERSPECTIVE and SIDE views, all cabin pixels, hull design, drum size/thickness, colors, material detail, title and layout. Do NOT redesign or grow anything in those views. The rear drum is reoriented with its axis along the fuselage, circle looking forward/backward. The main perspective and side establish its actual size. Image 2 reinforces the original cockpit identity; do not touch it. Image 3 is native wing flight layout/motion for reference only.

Only correct the LOWER-RIGHT TOP view so it describes the same geometry:
- Current TOP incorrectly makes the transverse rear drum only about one cabin-width wide. A circle seen edge-on from above projects to its full DIAMETER horizontally. Make its TOP projected crosswise band about 1.9 times the cabin's visible top-view width, comfortably less than the wing span. Keep the SAME band's front-to-back thickness. This is a projection fix, NOT physical drum enlargement: do not change drum in main perspective or side at all. Its axis runs UP/DOWN the page and its broad width runs LEFT/RIGHT. The band remains behind the neck, above the two engines.
- Exactly TWO compact engines, left and right, exhausts aft / down-page. Keep their size and separation, with sensible occlusion under the newly corrected drum projection. Remove any accidental central third nozzle: any small central base is closed solid hull, not an exhaust.
- Keep the cabin completely UNCHANGED in ALL views, especially its scale, glass and chin. No new cockpit redraw. Keep the central closed rectangular baydoor and the rearward clearance below the elevated drum. No new arrows.

Additional F03-specific change, ONLY if the title says F03:
Its TOP wings are currently swept BACK toward the engine, unlike the source and side. Reverse only the TOP wing sweep. Nose UP. Left outer wing tip must lie substantially UP-LEFT from root; right tip UP-RIGHT, closer to the cockpit. Whole panels angle toward nose. Preserve sockets, wing span, angular clipped tips and markings. The main/side forward flight wing geometry stays unchanged. This is flight, no tips folding upward.
For F04 the TOP wing sweep is already correct: leave its wings intact.

Do not alter anything else. Same two design directions and same all-view cockpit. Preserve image 1 as much as possible. Exactly one corrected sheet, same title.
